reference_semantic_plan.program:
SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2024.csv, [text])
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, text)
-> SEM_FILTER('The filing describes a company operating in a retail industry.', {document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name, reported employee count, and specific retail subsector.', {company_name: string, employee_count: integer, retail_subsector: string}, {document: text})
-> ORDER_BY([employee_count DESC, company_name ASC])
-> LIMIT(3)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2024.csv, [text])
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, text)
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the fiscal year-end date and normalize it to MM-DD format.', {fiscal_year_end: string}, {document: text})
-> FILTER(fiscal_year_end != '12-31')
-> GROUP_BY([fiscal_year_end], [COUNT(*) AS count])
-> ORDER_BY([count DESC, fiscal_year_end ASC])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [text])
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, text)
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the industry sector and count the distinct risk factors listed in Item 1A; return null for the count when it cannot be determined reliably.', {industry: string, risk_factor_count: integer|null}, {document: text})
-> GROUP_BY([industry], [ROUND(AVG(risk_factor_count), 1) AS avg_risk_factor_count, COUNT(risk_factor_count) AS filing_count])
-> FILTER(filing_count >= 10)
-> ORDER_BY([avg_risk_factor_count DESC, industry ASC])
-> LIMIT(5)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [text, word_count]) -> FILTER(word_count > 100000) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to exactly one primary revenue-model category; leave it unassigned only when no primary model can be determined', target_labels=['mixed', 'product_sales', 'interest_income', 'service_fees', 'licensing_royalties', 'rental_income', 'investment_returns', 'subscription', 'commission'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text}) -> FILTER(revenue_model IS NOT NULL) -> GROUP_BY([revenue_model], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2022.csv, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract a canonical industry sector and whether the filing expresses going-concern doubt; normalize case, separators, and synonymous sector labels, including blank-check and SPAC naming variants', {industry_sector: string, has_going_concern_doubt: boolean}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([industry_sector], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count, SUM(has_going_concern_doubt) AS going_concern_count, SUM(has_going_concern_doubt) / COUNT(*) AS unrounded_rate, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_going_concern_doubt) / COUNT(*), 1) AS going_concern_rate_percent]) -> FILTER(filing_count >= 20) -> ORDER_BY(unrounded_rate DESC, industry_sector ASC) -> LIMIT(3)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2022.csv, [cik, text, word_count]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name and industry sector; record up to ten distinct named subsidiaries and up to eight distinct competitive-advantage themes, and return both capped counts', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string, subsidiary_count: integer, competitive_advantages_count: integer}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> FILTER(subsidiary_count >= 8 AND competitive_advantages_count >= 6) -> GROUP_BY([cik], [MAX_BY(STRUCT(company_name, industry_sector, competitive_advantages_count, subsidiary_count, competitive_advantages_count + subsidiary_count AS combined_count) ORDER BY combined_count DESC, word_count DESC) AS selected_record]) -> ORDER_BY(selected_record.combined_count DESC, selected_record.company_name ASC) -> LIMIT(10) -> PROJECT([selected_record.company_name AS company_name, selected_record.competitive_advantages_count AS competitive_advantages_count, selected_record.subsidiary_count AS subsidiary_count, selected_record.industry_sector AS industry_sector])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [year, text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Determine whether the filing specifically mentions artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, neural networks, AI-powered or similar AI/ML technologies in the context of the company's business, products, or strategy', {ai_ml_mentioned: boolean}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([year], [ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ai_ml_mentioned) / COUNT(*), 1) AS ai_ml_mention_rate_percent]) -> ORDER_BY(year ASC)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [year, text]) -> FILTER(year BETWEEN 2019 AND 2023) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Determine whether the filing expresses substantial doubt about the company's ability to continue as a going concern', {has_going_concern: boolean}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([year], [ROUND(100.0 * SUM(has_going_concern) / COUNT(*), 1) AS going_concern_rate_percent]) -> ORDER_BY(year ASC)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Record from zero to eight distinct competitive-advantage themes and classify the company as market_leader when the filing describes it as a market leader, or other otherwise', {competitive_advantage_count: integer, competitive_position: string}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> PROJECT([CASE WHEN competitive_advantage_count = 8 THEN 'high_advantage_group' ELSE 'low_advantage_group' END AS advantage_group, competitive_position = 'market_leader' AS is_market_leader]) -> GROUP_BY([advantage_group], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(is_market_leader), 1) AS market_leader_rate_percent])

value_schema.filing_count: integer — number of filings in the group
value_schema.market_leader_rate_percent: float — percentage classified as market leaders, rounded to one decimal

reference_semantic_plan.program: SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Determine whether the filing mentions ESG or sustainability topics and whether it contains a qualifying AI/ML technology reference', {esg_mentioned: boolean, ai_ml_mentioned: boolean}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([], [SUM(CASE WHEN esg_mentioned = true AND ai_ml_mentioned = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS both_esg_and_ai_ml, SUM(CASE WHEN esg_mentioned = true AND ai_ml_mentioned = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS esg_only, SUM(CASE WHEN esg_mentioned = false AND ai_ml_mentioned = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ai_ml_only, SUM(CASE WHEN esg_mentioned = false AND ai_ml_mentioned = false THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS neither])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Classify geographic operating scope as domestic_only, limited_international, globally_diversified, or unassigned, and determine whether the filing reports foreign-currency risk, international operations, and litigation or legal proceedings', {geographic_level: string, foreign_currency_risk: boolean, has_international_ops: boolean, has_litigation: boolean}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> FILTER(geographic_level IN ['domestic_only', 'limited_international', 'globally_diversified']) -> GROUP_BY([geographic_level], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(foreign_currency_risk), 1) AS foreign_currency_risk_rate_percent, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(has_international_ops), 1) AS international_operations_rate_percent, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(has_litigation), 1) AS litigation_rate_percent])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [year, text]) -> FILTER(year IN [2022, 2023]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the industry sector and determine whether the filing mentions AI or machine-learning technologies', {industry_sector: string, ai_ml_mentioned: boolean}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([industry_sector], [SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2022 AND ai_ml_mentioned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ai_ml_filings_2022, SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 AND ai_ml_mentioned THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ai_ml_filings_2023, SUM(CASE WHEN year = 2023 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_filings_2023]) -> FILTER(total_filings_2023 >= 20 AND ai_ml_filings_2023 > ai_ml_filings_2022) -> ORDER_BY(ai_ml_filings_2023 - ai_ml_filings_2022 DESC, industry_sector ASC) -> LIMIT(10)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [year, text, word_count]) -> FILTER(year IN [2019, 2020, 2021, 2022, 2023] AND word_count > 95000) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that explicitly report exactly zero employees', {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([], [COUNT(*) AS count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [year, text, word_count]) -> FILTER(year IN [2020, 2021, 2022, 2023] AND word_count > 90000) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings with an identifiable disclosed fiscal-year-end date that, after month-day normalization, is not December 31', {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([], [COUNT(*) AS count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2024.csv, [text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 50000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe operational use of artificial intelligence or machine learning.', {document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that do not report substantial doubt about continuing as a going concern.', {document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name and its industry sector.', {company_name: string, industry: string}, {document: text})
-> ORDER_BY([word_count DESC, company_name ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2019.csv, [cik, text AS text_2019]) AS filings_2019
SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [cik, text AS text_2023]) AS filings_2023
filings_2019 -> JOIN(inner, filings_2019.cik = filings_2023.cik) <- filings_2023
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, text_2023)
-> FILTER(CONTAINS_CASE_INSENSITIVE(document_2023, 'artificial intelligence') OR CONTAINS_CASE_INSENSITIVE(document_2023, 'machine learning'))
-> DEDUP([cik], keep=first)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, text_2019)
-> FILTER(NOT CONTAINS_CASE_INSENSITIVE(document_2019, 'artificial intelligence') AND NOT CONTAINS_CASE_INSENSITIVE(document_2019, 'machine learning'))
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the 2023 industry sector.', {industry_sector: string}, {document: document_2023})
-> GROUP_BY([industry_sector], [COUNT(*) AS company_count])
-> ORDER_BY([company_count DESC, industry_sector ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2022.csv, [text, word_count])
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, text)
-> SEM_FILTER('The filing does not describe substantive business operations outside the United States.', {document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('The filing discusses environmental, social, or governance topics.', {document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract and normalize the company legal name and industry sector.', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string}, {document: text})
-> DEDUP([company_name], keep=max(word_count))
-> ORDER_BY([word_count DESC, company_name ASC])
-> LIMIT(5)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to exactly one primary revenue-model category; leave it unassigned only when no primary model can be determined', target_labels=['advertising', 'commission', 'interest_income', 'investment_returns', 'licensing_royalties', 'mixed', 'product_sales', 'rental_income', 'service_fees', 'subscription'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text}) -> FILTER(revenue_model IS NOT NULL) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the reported employee count; return null when no explicit total is disclosed', {employee_count: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([revenue_model], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count, ROUND(AVG(employee_count IGNORE NULLS), 0) AS average_employee_count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [cik, year, text, word_count]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to one competitive-position category', target_labels=['market_leader', 'major_player', 'challenger', 'niche_player', 'emerging'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([cik], [COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN competitive_position = 'market_leader' THEN year END) AS leader_years, MAX_BY(CASE WHEN year = 2024 AND NOT CONTAINS_CASE_INSENSITIVE(document_text, 'FORM 10-K/A') THEN document_text END, CASE WHEN year = 2024 AND NOT CONTAINS_CASE_INSENSITIVE(document_text, 'FORM 10-K/A') THEN word_count END) AS primary_2024_filing]) -> FILTER(leader_years = 6) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name and industry sector from the retained non-amended 2024 filing', {company_name: string, industry: string}, {filing_text: primary_2024_filing}) -> ORDER_BY(company_name ASC)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its industry sector for this comparison', target_labels=['Pharmaceutical', 'Software', 'Other'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text}) -> FILTER(industry_sector IN ['Pharmaceutical', 'Software']) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Determine whether the filing contains a qualifying AI/ML reference, expresses going-concern doubt, describes international operations, and reports litigation or legal proceedings', {ai_ml_mentioned: boolean, has_going_concern: boolean, has_international_ops: boolean, has_litigation: boolean}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([industry_sector], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(ai_ml_mentioned), 1) AS ai_ml_mention_rate_percent, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(has_going_concern), 1) AS going_concern_rate_percent, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(has_international_ops), 1) AS international_operations_rate_percent, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(has_litigation), 1) AS litigation_rate_percent])

value_schema.filing_count: integer — number of filings in the industry
value_schema.ai_ml_mention_rate_percent: float — percentage mentioning AI/ML, rounded to one decimal
value_schema.going_concern_rate_percent: float — percentage expressing going-concern doubt, rounded to one decimal
value_schema.international_operations_rate_percent: float — percentage describing international operations, rounded to one decimal
value_schema.litigation_rate_percent: float — percentage reporting litigation, rounded to one decimal

reference_semantic_plan.program: SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2019.csv, [cik, text, word_count]) -> GROUP_BY([cik], [MAX_BY(text, word_count) AS primary_text_2019]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=primary_text_2019) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign the filing to its primary revenue-model category', target_labels=['advertising', 'commission', 'interest_income', 'investment_returns', 'licensing_royalties', 'mixed', 'product_sales', 'rental_income', 'service_fees', 'subscription', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text}) AS models_2019 ||| SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [cik, text, word_count]) -> GROUP_BY([cik], [MAX_BY(text, word_count) AS primary_text_2023]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=primary_text_2023) -> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign the filing to its primary revenue-model category', target_labels=['advertising', 'commission', 'interest_income', 'investment_returns', 'licensing_royalties', 'mixed', 'product_sales', 'rental_income', 'service_fees', 'subscription', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text}) AS models_2023 ||| JOIN(inner, models_2019.cik = models_2023.cik) -> FILTER(models_2019.revenue_model != 'undetermined' AND models_2023.revenue_model != 'undetermined' AND models_2019.revenue_model != models_2023.revenue_model) -> PROJECT([models_2019.revenue_model || ' -> ' || models_2023.revenue_model AS transition]) -> GROUP_BY([transition], [COUNT(*) AS count]) -> ORDER_BY(count DESC, transition ASC) -> LIMIT(10)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [year, text, word_count]) -> FILTER(year IN [2021, 2022, 2023] AND word_count > 90000) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings for companies incorporated in one of the 50 U.S. states or the District of Columbia', {filing_text: document_text}) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings whose headquarters country is outside the United States', {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([], [COUNT(*) AS count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [year, text, word_count]) -> FILTER(year IN [2022, 2023] AND word_count > 80000) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe artificial-intelligence or machine-learning use in the company business', {filing_text: document_text}) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that do not mention environmental, social, governance, ESG, or sustainability topics', {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([], [COUNT(*) AS count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [year, text, word_count]) -> FILTER(year IN [2019, 2020, 2021] AND word_count > 80000) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that state the company has international operations', {filing_text: document_text}) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that do not disclose foreign-currency risk', {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([], [COUNT(*) AS count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2019.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 45000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that disclose dependence on a major customer or material customer concentration', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that do not disclose foreign-currency or exchange-rate risk', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe operations outside the United States', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name, industry sector, and reported employee count', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string, employee_count: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(employee_count IS NOT NULL)
-> DEDUP([company_name], keep=max_by(employee_count, word_count, cik))
-> ORDER_BY([employee_count DESC, LOWER(company_name) ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)
-> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector, employee_count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2020.csv, [text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 50000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that express substantial doubt about continuing as a going concern', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that report pending, threatened, or ongoing litigation, legal proceedings, lawsuits, or regulatory investigations', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its stated growth-strategy category', target_labels=['organic', 'acquisition_driven', 'hybrid', 'not_applicable', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(growth_strategy != 'undetermined')
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the reported employee count and total number of risk factors', {employee_count: integer|null, risk_factor_count: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text})
-> GROUP_BY([growth_strategy], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count, ROUND(MEDIAN(employee_count IGNORE NULLS), 1) AS median_employee_count, ROUND(MEDIAN(risk_factor_count IGNORE NULLS), 1) AS median_risk_factor_count])
-> FILTER(filing_count >= 10)
-> ORDER_BY([filing_count DESC, growth_strategy ASC])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2021.csv, [text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 60000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that mention artificial intelligence or machine learning', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its primary revenue-model category', target_labels=['advertising', 'commission', 'interest_income', 'investment_returns', 'licensing_royalties', 'mixed', 'product_sales', 'rental_income', 'service_fees', 'subscription', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its competitive-position category', target_labels=['emerging', 'niche_player', 'challenger', 'major_player', 'market_leader', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(revenue_model != 'undetermined' AND competitive_position != 'undetermined')
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract whether ESG or sustainability topics are mentioned and the total number of risk factors', {esg_mentioned: boolean, risk_factor_count: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text})
-> GROUP_BY([revenue_model, competitive_position], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count, ROUND(100.0 * AVG(esg_mentioned), 1) AS esg_mention_rate_percent, ROUND(MEDIAN(risk_factor_count IGNORE NULLS), 1) AS median_risk_factor_count])
-> FILTER(filing_count >= 10)
-> ORDER_BY([filing_count DESC, revenue_model ASC, competitive_position ASC])
-> LIMIT(5)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2021.csv, [cik, text])
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, text)
-> SEM_FILTER('The filing reports substantial doubt about continuing as a going concern.', {document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('The filing reports pending litigation.', {document: text})
-> SEM_FILTER('The filing reports that a single customer accounts for at least 10% of revenue.', {document: text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the industry sector.', {industry_sector: string}, {document: text})
-> DEDUP([cik], keep=first)
-> GROUP_BY([industry_sector], [COUNT(*) AS company_count])
-> ORDER_BY([company_count DESC, industry_sector ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2019.csv, [cik, text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe the company as holding a challenger competitive position in 2019', {filing_text: document_text}) -> PROJECT([cik]) AS challengers_2019 ||| SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [cik, text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe the company as a recognized industry or market leader in 2023', {filing_text: document_text}) -> DEDUP([cik], keep=first) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name and industry sector stated or clearly supported by the filing', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string}, {filing_text: document_text}) AS leaders_2023 ||| JOIN(inner, challengers_2019.cik = leaders_2023.cik) -> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2022.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 60000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that disclose dependence on a major customer or material customer concentration', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that disclose foreign-currency or exchange-rate risk', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its stated growth-strategy category', target_labels=['organic', 'acquisition_driven', 'hybrid', 'not_applicable', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(growth_strategy IN ['acquisition_driven', 'hybrid'])
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name, industry sector, countries of operation, and names of disclosed subsidiaries', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string, countries_of_operation: list[string], subsidiary_names: list[string]}, {filing_text: document_text})
-> PROJECT([cik, word_count, company_name, industry_sector, growth_strategy, COUNT_DISTINCT(NORMALIZE_COUNTRY(countries_of_operation) EXCLUDING 'United States') AS country_count, COUNT_DISTINCT(NORMALIZE_ENTITY(subsidiary_names)) AS subsidiary_count])
-> FILTER(country_count > 0)
-> DEDUP([company_name], keep=max_by(country_count, subsidiary_count, word_count, cik))
-> ORDER_BY([country_count DESC, subsidiary_count DESC, LOWER(company_name) ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)
-> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector, growth_strategy, country_count, subsidiary_count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2019.csv, [cik, text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) AS filings_2019 ||| SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2020.csv, [cik, text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) AS filings_2020 ||| JOIN(inner, filings_2019.cik = filings_2020.cik) AS paired_filings -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filing pairs whose 2020 filing includes a pandemic or public-health risk factor', {filing_text: filings_2020.document_text}) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filing pairs whose 2019 filing does not include a pandemic or public-health risk factor', {filing_text: filings_2019.document_text}) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the total risk-factor count from each annual filing and the 2020 industry sector', {risk_factor_count_2019: integer|null, risk_factor_count_2020: integer|null, industry_sector_2020: string}, {filing_text_2019: filings_2019.document_text, filing_text_2020: filings_2020.document_text}) AS adopters ||| adopters -> GROUP_BY([industry_sector_2020], [COUNT(DISTINCT cik) AS adopter_count]) -> ORDER_BY(adopter_count DESC, industry_sector_2020 ASC) -> LIMIT(10) AS top_sectors ||| adopters -> GROUP_BY([], [ROUND(AVG(risk_factor_count_2020 - risk_factor_count_2019 IGNORE NULLS), 1) AS mean_risk_factor_count_change]) AS change_summary

reference_semantic_plan.program: SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2019.csv, [cik, text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe the company as an early-stage or emerging competitor in 2019', {filing_text: document_text}) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the reported employee count; return null when no explicit total is disclosed', {employee_count_2019: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text}) AS emerging_2019 ||| SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [cik, text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe the company as a recognized industry or market leader in 2023', {filing_text: document_text}) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name, industry sector, and reported employee count', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string, employee_count_2023: integer}, {filing_text: document_text}) AS leaders_2023 ||| JOIN(inner, emerging_2019.cik = leaders_2023.cik) -> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector, employee_count_2019, employee_count_2023])

reference_semantic_plan.program:
SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 60000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe the company operating footprint as exclusively domestic, with no operations outside the United States', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that disclose foreign-currency or exchange-rate risk', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name, industry sector, and total number of risk factors', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string, risk_factor_count: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(company_name IS NOT NULL AND industry_sector IS NOT NULL AND risk_factor_count IS NOT NULL)
-> DEDUP([company_name], keep=max_by(risk_factor_count, word_count, cik))
-> ORDER_BY([risk_factor_count DESC, LOWER(company_name) ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)
-> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector, risk_factor_count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 60000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that identify acquisition-integration risk', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that report pending, threatened, or ongoing litigation, legal proceedings, lawsuits, or regulatory investigations', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its competitive-position category', target_labels=['emerging', 'niche_player', 'challenger', 'major_player', 'market_leader', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name, industry sector, reported employee count, and number of distinct merger or acquisition transactions mentioned', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string, employee_count: integer|null, ma_transaction_count: integer}, {filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(competitive_position != 'undetermined' AND ma_transaction_count >= 3 AND employee_count IS NOT NULL)
-> DEDUP([company_name], keep=max_by(employee_count, ma_transaction_count, word_count, cik))
-> ORDER_BY([employee_count DESC, LOWER(company_name) ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)
-> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector, competitive_position, employee_count, ma_transaction_count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2020.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 55000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that identify climate-change risk', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its entity-type category', target_labels=['operating_company', 'holding_company', 'investment_fund', 'blank_check_SPAC', 'shell_company', 'limited_partnership', 'business_development_company', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its stated growth-strategy category', target_labels=['organic', 'acquisition_driven', 'hybrid', 'not_applicable', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the company legal name, industry sector, and total number of risk factors', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string, risk_factor_count: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(entity_type != 'undetermined' AND growth_strategy != 'undetermined' AND risk_factor_count IS NOT NULL)
-> DEDUP([company_name], keep=max_by(risk_factor_count, word_count, cik))
-> ORDER_BY([risk_factor_count DESC, LOWER(company_name) ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)
-> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector, entity_type, growth_strategy, risk_factor_count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2021.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 60000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its geographic operating-footprint category', target_labels=['domestic_only', 'limited_international', 'globally_diversified', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(geographic_diversification = 'domestic_only')
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that do not disclose foreign-currency or exchange-rate risk', {filing_text: document_text})
-> DEDUP([cik], keep=max_by(word_count)) AS baseline_2021
|||
SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2023.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 60000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its geographic operating-footprint category', target_labels=['domestic_only', 'limited_international', 'globally_diversified', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(geographic_diversification = 'globally_diversified')
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that disclose foreign-currency or exchange-rate risk', {filing_text: document_text})
-> DEDUP([cik], keep=max_by(word_count)) AS expanded_2023
|||
JOIN(inner, baseline_2021.cik = expanded_2023.cik) AS transitions
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign the 2023 filing to its stated growth-strategy category', target_labels=['organic', 'acquisition_driven', 'hybrid', 'not_applicable', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: expanded_2023.document_text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the 2023 company legal name, industry sector, and countries of operation', {company_name: string, industry_sector: string, countries_of_operation: list[string]}, {filing_text: expanded_2023.document_text})
-> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector, growth_strategy, COUNT_DISTINCT(NORMALIZE_COUNTRY(countries_of_operation) EXCLUDING 'United States') AS foreign_country_count])
-> ORDER_BY([foreign_country_count DESC, LOWER(company_name) ASC])
-> LIMIT(10)
-> PROJECT([company_name, industry_sector, growth_strategy, foreign_country_count])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2022.csv, [text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 65000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that express substantial doubt about continuing as a going concern', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings that describe operations outside the United States', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_CLASSIFY('Assign each filing to its competitive-position category', target_labels=['emerging', 'niche_player', 'challenger', 'major_player', 'market_leader', 'undetermined'], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(competitive_position != 'undetermined')
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the reported employee count', {employee_count: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text}) AS qualified_filings
|||
qualified_filings
-> GROUP_BY([competitive_position], [COUNT(*) AS filing_count, ROUND(MEDIAN(employee_count IGNORE NULLS), 1) AS median_employee_count]) AS position_stats
|||
qualified_filings
-> SEM_AGGREGATE('For each competitive-position group, identify the most prevalent risk theme from debt_financing, regulatory_compliance, litigation_legal, key_personnel, customer_concentration, intellectual_property, and cybersecurity; break frequency ties alphabetically', {top_risk_theme: string}, group_by=[competitive_position], input_bindings={filing_text: document_text}) AS theme_summary
|||
JOIN(inner, position_stats.competitive_position = theme_summary.competitive_position)
-> FILTER(filing_count >= 10)
-> PROJECT([competitive_position, filing_count, median_employee_count, top_risk_theme])
-> ORDER_BY([filing_count DESC, competitive_position ASC])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2020.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 50000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings for companies whose primary business is software or a technology platform', {filing_text: document_text})
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the acquirer legal name, its industry sector, and names of whole companies it acquired or agreed to acquire; exclude asset purchases, minority-stake investments, spin-offs, and SPAC or blank-check combinations', {acquirer: string, acquirer_sector: string, acquired_company_names: list[string]}, {filing_text: document_text})
-> FILTER(LENGTH(acquired_company_names) > 0) AS acquisition_events
|||
SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV/2019.csv, [cik, text, word_count])
-> FILTER(word_count > 50000)
-> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text)
-> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the registrant legal name, industry sector, and total number of risk factors', {registry_company_name: string, target_sector: string, target_risk_factor_count: integer|null}, {filing_text: document_text}) AS registry_2019
|||
SEM_JOIN('Match each acquired-company reference to the 2019 filing registrant that is the same legal entity despite abbreviations, former names, spelling variants, or legal-suffix differences; reject merely similar but unrelated names', input_bindings_left={acquired_company_names: acquisition_events.acquired_company_names, acquisition_context: acquisition_events.document_text}, input_bindings_right={registry_company_name: registry_2019.registry_company_name, registry_context: registry_2019.document_text})
-> FILTER(acquisition_events.cik != registry_2019.cik AND acquisition_events.acquirer_sector != registry_2019.target_sector AND registry_2019.target_risk_factor_count IS NOT NULL)
-> PROJECT([acquisition_events.acquirer AS acquirer, registry_2019.registry_company_name AS target, registry_2019.target_sector AS target_sector, registry_2019.target_risk_factor_count AS target_risk_factor_count])
-> DEDUP([acquirer, target])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings for companies in the Software industry sector', {filing_text: document_text}) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the filing company legal name and names of whole-company merger or acquisition counterparties; exclude asset purchases, minority investments, spin-offs, single-company going-private recapitalizations, and SPAC or blank-check combinations', {company_name: string, counterparty_names: list[string]}, {filing_text: document_text}) AS software_events ||| software_events -> FILTER(LENGTH(counterparty_names) > 0) AS candidate_events ||| software_events -> DEDUP([company_name]) AS software_registry ||| SEM_JOIN('Match each named counterparty to the same legal entity in the software-company filing registry despite harmless naming variations', input_bindings_left={counterparty_names: candidate_events.counterparty_names}, input_bindings_right={registry_company_name: software_registry.company_name}) -> FILTER(candidate_events.company_name != software_registry.company_name) -> PROJECT([CASE WHEN LOWER(candidate_events.company_name) <= LOWER(software_registry.company_name) THEN candidate_events.company_name ELSE software_registry.company_name END AS company_a, CASE WHEN LOWER(candidate_events.company_name) <= LOWER(software_registry.company_name) THEN software_registry.company_name ELSE candidate_events.company_name END AS company_b]) -> DEDUP([company_a, company_b])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_FILTER('Keep filings for companies whose primary business is software or a technology platform', {filing_text: document_text}) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the acquirer legal name, its industry sector, and names of whole companies it acquired or agreed to acquire; exclude asset purchases, minority investments, spin-offs, and SPAC or blank-check combinations', {acquirer: string, acquirer_sector: string, acquired_company_names: list[string]}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> FILTER(LENGTH(acquired_company_names) > 0) AS acquisition_events ||| SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [cik, year, text, word_count]) -> GROUP_BY([cik], [MIN_BY(text, year ASC, word_count DESC) AS registry_text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=registry_text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the filing company legal name and industry sector', {registry_company_name: string, target_sector: string}, {filing_text: document_text}) AS company_registry ||| SEM_JOIN('Match each acquired-company name to the same legal entity in the filing registry despite harmless naming variations', input_bindings_left={acquired_company_names: acquisition_events.acquired_company_names}, input_bindings_right={registry_company_name: company_registry.registry_company_name}) -> FILTER(acquisition_events.acquirer != company_registry.registry_company_name AND acquisition_events.acquirer_sector != company_registry.target_sector) -> PROJECT([acquisition_events.acquirer AS acquirer, company_registry.registry_company_name AS target, company_registry.target_sector AS target_sector]) -> DEDUP([acquirer, target])

SCAN_TABLE(SEC10K, CSV, [text]) -> SCAN_DOCS(SEC10K, doc_ids=text) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract the filing company legal name and names of wholly-owned finance or funding subsidiaries', {company_name: string, finance_subsidiary_names: list[string]}, {filing_text: document_text}) -> GROUP_BY([company_name], [UNION_DISTINCT(finance_subsidiary_names) AS finance_subsidiary_names, COLLECT(document_text) AS filing_texts]) AS companies ||| companies -> FILTER(LENGTH(finance_subsidiary_names) > 0) AS finance_candidates ||| SEM_JOIN('Match each finance-subsidiary name to the same legal entity in the filer registry and emit the matched registry name as finance_company_name', input_bindings_left={finance_subsidiary_names: finance_candidates.finance_subsidiary_names}, input_bindings_right={registry_name: companies.company_name}) AS finance_matches -> FILTER(finance_matches.company_name != finance_company_name) -> SEM_EXTRACT('Extract names of qualifying whole-company merger or acquisition counterparties; exclude asset purchases, minority-stake investments, spin-offs, and SPAC or blank-check combinations', {ma_counterparty_names: list[string]}, {filing_texts: finance_matches.filing_texts}) AS ma_candidates -> SEM_JOIN('Match each M&A-counterparty name to the same legal entity in the filer registry and emit the matched registry name as ma_company_name', input_bindings_left={ma_counterparty_names: ma_candidates.ma_counterparty_names}, input_bindings_right={registry_name: companies.company_name}) -> FILTER(ma_candidates.company_name != ma_company_name AND finance_company_name != ma_company_name) -> PROJECT([ma_candidates.company_name AS company, ma_company_name AS ma_counterparty, finance_company_name AS finance_subsidiary]) -> DEDUP([company, ma_counterparty, finance_subsidiary])
